review_method: Assistant inspected original timestamped frame grids at 500 ms; individual advance/retreat/jump-lunge also inspected at approximately 100 ms. No fencing expert or continuous-playback review.
limitations: Every segment is provisional; no accuracy ground truth claimed.
The MIT cohort is one split group; crops/people/adjacent clips are not independent evaluation data.
Movement boundary uncertainty is recorded; ambiguous transitions are left unlabeled.
No verified fleche or counterattack intervals yet.
